milestones.title: The load test's start bursts show whether starts at the same moment fail

remediation: Upstream Theia Cloud fails with a NullPointerException when it checks the instance limit while another new session has no status yet. Starts one at a time work, and the start page launches one session for each person. Report it upstream, and check with the load test's start bursts whether different people starting together are affected.
title: Starting two sessions at the same moment can fail in Theia Cloud
